preconditions.description: All node coordinates must be within the range of -1000 to 1000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not can_build_tree(points) else True
postconditions.description: If it is impossible to build a binary root tree, output -1.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(total_length) if can_build_tree(points) else True
postconditions.description: If a binary root tree can be built, output the total length of the arcs.

postconditions.expression: abs(float(stdout) - total_length) <= 1e-6 or abs((float(stdout) - total_length) / total_length) <= 1e-6 if can_build_tree(points) else True
